title: Final Project: Data Pipeline
concept: Build a complete generic data pipeline using all L5 concepts — generics, interfaces, iterators, derive macros, and design patterns working together.
why: Real projects don't use concepts in isolation. This capstone project integrates everything you've learned in L5 into a practical, working system.
tips: This project pattern (parse → validate → transform → collect) appears in virtually every production system
The generic pipeline is reusable — swap transform/validate implementations for different data types
Test each transformer and validator independently before assembling the pipeline
Consider error accumulation: collect all validation failures instead of failing on the first one
common_mistakes: Over-abstracting: a pipeline with 2 steps doesn't need a full generic framework
Not handling errors in each step — transformers should return Result, not panic on bad input
Mixing concerns: validators should only validate, transformers should only transform
